causalDefinitions.primary: D-1 fastSMA(close) <= slowSMA(close) AND D fastSMA(close) > slowSMA(close)
causalDefinitions.context: D-1 contextState <= volThreshold AND D contextState > volThreshold

samplePolicy.basis: Reuse the pre-existing EXP-MA-STATE-INCREMENTAL-001 MINIMUM_SAMPLE_COUNT=8 research standard; this value is registered before observing any fresh outcome.
samplePolicy.cohortRule: Use exactly the first 8 chronologically matured composite decision events after 2026-08-13, ordered by decisionDate then symbol.
samplePolicy.maturityRule: An event is eligible only when D+1 open plus all 5 outcome sessions are finalized and available.

baselinePolicy.window: All matured MA_FRESH_CROSS_UP events with decisionDate after 2026-08-13 and on or before the eighth composite event decisionDate.

interpretationBoundary: This is prospective validation of one frozen candidate, not another Discovery search.
The first eight-event cohort rule removes run-date dependence and prevents optional stopping after viewing fresh outcome metrics.
A pass means the frozen candidate replicated the pre-registered directional criteria on fresh events; it does not establish deployable profitability.
A fail closes this candidate lineage without parameter rescue.
